analysis:
The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds a 'Requests served since the daemon started' status bullet (head lines ~990-1001) describing local request and output-token counters, with a link to the coordinator's heartbeat.go (cumulativeDelta) at an immutable platform commit. No code, config, key handling, wire contract, authorization, encryption or cache behavior changes. The base unit (lines 1726-1974) and the head unit (lines 1-397) are unchanged context and only partially cover the changed hunk. The head excerpt does not include the new bullet, so its text comes from the patch only.

Threat-model review: the new text describes counters only (no prompts, tokens, keys or identities), so it does not touch A-001, A-003, A-008, A-015/A-016 or the cache threat T-041. It states that early-ended requests may not be paid and that paid jobs are on the console's Earnings page, which is accurate to the documented coordinator-trusted model. It introduces no claim of attestation, secrecy or correct computation (T-056) and makes no policy or receipt claims (T-054/T-057). The immutable-link practice matches the threat model's convention. Remaining unverified: the correctness of the referenced coordinator counter semantics, which is a platform-owned backend outside the supplied evidence. This is a documentation-accuracy matter, not a security regression. I did not review the unchanged documentation in the supplied excerpts for pre-existing issues.
